bind_address.description: Network address (host:port or just port) to bind the server to

connection_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for an incoming connection before timing out

packet_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a complete encrypted packet before disconnecting

max_connections.description: Maximum number of queued incoming connections

enable_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for client communication

tls_certificate_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate (PEM format) — required if TLS is enabled

tls_private_key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key (PEM format) — required if TLS is enabled

tls_ca_file.description: Path to the CA certificate (PEM format) for verifying clients — optional, enables client cert auth

log_file.description: Path to the log file; use '-' to log to stdout (e.g., with systemd)

run_as_user.description: System user to run the server process as

run_as_group.description: System group to run the server process as (optional)

command_pipe.description: Path to the command FIFO (named pipe) where NSCA-NG writes processed checks

enable_include_dir.description: Enable reading extra config files from a directory (e.g., per-client configs)

include_dir.description: Directory to scan for additional .cfg files (if enabled)

allowed_clients.description: List of allowed client hosts (IP or hostname) and their authentication details

host.description: IP address or hostname allowed to connect

password.description: Shared secret password (plaintext or hash) for this client

encryption.description: Encryption method: 'none', 'aes256', 'aes192', 'aes128', 'blowfish', etc. (defaults to server-wide TLS if enabled)
